page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.s3 server family. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores, resulting in 1.0 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage resources must be provisioned externally. There are no integrated GPUs, and the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The CPU flags for advanced vector extensions (AVX, AVX-512), matrix extensions (AMX), cryptography acceleration (AES, SHA), and virtualization extensions (VMX, SVM) are not enabled or supported on this instance. The lack of hyperthreading and advanced instruction sets represents a tradeoff, limiting its suitability for workloads requiring heavy vector mathematics, hardware-accelerated encryption, or nested virtualization.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s3.large is structured for compute-focused workloads that do not require large memory footprints. It is suitable for basic web serving, lightweight batch processing, and utility applications. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable compute performance for entry-level workloads without the overhead of high-capacity memory or local storage.
